Watch a Folder and Run a Process when Things Change with watchexe

Use watchexec to watch files in a directory and run a process when they change.

Basic Example

watchexec -c -r -e py,html ./process.py

Details

  • -c clears the screen before each run

  • -r kills and restarts the process if it's still running

  • -e ext1,etc2 sets the file extensions to watch

Notes

  • watchexec does some shenanigans with looking for parent git repos to determine which directory to start watching in.
